text: Correction to my last reply: it IS built. Since v0.114.14 a red STAY AWAY banner shows at the top of the Feed card, the Bet sheet, CNO rows and PropLine +EV rows for bet types your history says lose (big samples only), and the engine hard-blocks those types. I was wrong to say it wasn't. If you see none, you are probably on an older app (check Settings > Diagnostics & about for the version; latest is 0.114.18, update from the Releases page) or no listed bet is currently one of those types. Tell me the version you see and a screenshot of a prop Over card and I'll chase it.
